_note: 學習路徑內容建置第15批 #2／6：have to / have got to 外在義務（eng.t_mid.modal.have-to，會考級／中階）。have to 表示來自外在（規定、環境）的義務。鐵律：he/she/it 用 has to；過去用 had to；疑問句與否定用 do/does/did＋have to；don't have to＝『不一定要』（非必要），不是『不可以』（mustn't）。誘答以『人稱 has/have 錯／缺 to／過去式錯／don't have to 誤解成禁止』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix hvt_）。

units.title_zh: have to / have got to（外在義務）
units.can_do: 我能用 have to 表達來自外在（規定、環境）的義務，知道 he/she/it 用 has to、過去用 had to、疑問與否定用 do/does/did＋have to，也知道 don't have to 是『不一定要』（非必要），不是『不可以』。
units.situation_group: 情態 have to（外在義務）
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'have to' expresses obligation that comes from outside the speaker (rules, laws, circumstances): 'I have to wear a uniform at school.'
claims.verification_ref: have to 表來自外在（規定/環境）的義務；I have to wear a uniform at school；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Use 'has to' with he, she or it, and 'had to' for the past: 'She has to get up early.' / 'We had to wait for the bus.'
claims.verification_ref: he/she/it 用 has to、過去用 had to；She has to get up early；We had to wait；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'don't/doesn't have to' means it is not necessary (no obligation), NOT prohibition: 'You don't have to come.' = you can if you want, but it is not required.
claims.verification_ref: don't/doesn't have to＝非必要（不是禁止）；You don't have to come＝可來可不來；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Questions use 'do/does/did + subject + have to': 'Do you have to work on Saturday?'. 'have to' is followed by the base form of the verb.
claims.verification_ref: 疑問句用 do/does/did＋主詞＋have to＋原形；Do you have to work on Saturday；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: have to 表示『必須』，而且這個義務是來自外在（像校規、法律、情況），不是說話者自己的意思。I have to wear a uniform at school.（我在學校必須穿制服——因為校規。）
I have to wear a uniform at school.
teach.zh_hint: 我在學校必須穿制服。外在規定。

teach.body: 重點：he／she／it 要用 has to；過去要用 had to。She has to get up early.（她必須早起。）We had to wait for the bus.（我們以前必須等公車。）have to 後面接動詞原形。
She has to get up early.
teach.zh_hint: 她必須早起。主詞 she 用 has to。

teach.body: 疑問句和否定用 do／does／did：Do you have to go?（你一定要去嗎？）小心：don't have to 是『不一定要』（非必要），不是『不可以』。You don't have to come.＝你來不來都行。
We had to wait for the bus.
teach.zh_hint: 我們必須等公車。過去用 had to。

practice.stem: 選正確：She ____ get up early every day.（她每天必須早起）

distractor_rationales.have to: 主詞 she 是第三人稱單數，要用 has to，不是 have to。
distractor_rationales.has: 少了 to；have／has 當『必須』要接 to：has to。
distractor_rationales.to have: 語序錯；第三人稱單數用 has to。

practice.feedback: 第三人稱單數用 has to：She has to get up early。

practice.stem: 'You don't have to wear a tie.' 這句的意思是？
practice.answer: 你不一定要戴領帶（不是必須）
options: 你不一定要戴領帶（不是必須）

distractor_rationales.你一定不可以戴領帶: 那是 mustn't（禁止）；don't have to 是『不一定要』，不是禁止。
distractor_rationales.你最好戴領帶: 那是 had better／should 的意思；don't have to 沒有建議的意思。
distractor_rationales.你以前常常戴領帶: 那是 used to 的意思；don't have to 講的是現在非必要。

practice.feedback: don't have to＝非必要（可做可不做），不是禁止。

practice.stem: 選正確：Yesterday we ____ wait for the bus for an hour.（昨天我們必須等公車一小時）

distractor_rationales.have to: 句子是過去（yesterday），過去的義務用 had to。
distractor_rationales.has to: 既是過去、主詞又是 we，應該用 had to。
distractor_rationales.having to: 這裡要動詞，不是分詞；過去用 had to。

practice.feedback: 過去的義務用 had to：we had to wait。

practice.stem: 選正確的問句開頭：____ you have to work on Saturday?（你星期六必須工作嗎？）

distractor_rationales.Are: have to 不是 be 動詞，疑問句不用 Are，要用 Do。
distractor_rationales.Have: 現代英語 have to 的疑問句用 Do you have to…，不用 Have you to…。
distractor_rationales.Does: 主詞 you 要用 Do，不是 Does。

practice.feedback: have to 疑問句用 Do：Do you have to work on Saturday?

practice.stem: 下面哪一句正確表達『學校規定我們必須穿制服』？
practice.answer: We have to wear a uniform.
options: We have to wear a uniform.
We has to wear a uniform.
We have to wearing a uniform.

少了 to；『必須』要用 have to。
主詞 we 用 have to，不是 has to。
have to 後面接原形 wear，不是 wearing。

practice.feedback: have to＋原形：We have to wear a uniform。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I have to finish my homework before dinner.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：have to finish（後接原形）有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。have to 連音、句尾依問句或直述調整。

lines.text: Do you have to go now?
lines.intonation: Do you have to go 上揚、now 疑問句尾可微升

lines.text: You don't have to come if you're busy.
lines.intonation: You don't have to come 起、if you're busy 句尾下收
